title: Extending Fill-In-the-Middle with Instructions for Steerable Code Completion
abstract: arXiv:2509.24637v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code completion models often fail when the developer's intent is under-specified in the code context. To mitigate this, developers frequently use natural language comments to clarify objectives. However, current code completion models fail to prioritize these directives effectively since they are merely pre-trained using the Fill-In-the-Middle (FIM) objective. On the one hand, the natural language instructions, mixed with the noisy code comments, are just treated as part of the background context within the prefix. translated_title: 通过指令扩展中间填充以实现可控的代码补全
translated_abstract: 当开发者的意图在代码上下文中未被充分说明时，代码补全模型往往会失败。为了缓解这一问题，开发者经常使用自然语言注释来阐明目标。然而，当前的代码补全模型无法有效地优先处理这些指令，因为它们仅仅通过中间填充目标进行预训练。一方面，与嘈杂的代码注释混杂在一起的自然语言指令，仅仅被视为前缀中背景上下文的一部分。另一方面，用于FIM目标的预训练数据集大多来源于开源代码库，这导致缺乏能够反映开发者在代码补全工作流程中的高意图指令到代码的配对数据。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了指令感知的中间填充（IFIM），这是一种微调方法，它通过一个专门的、结构上分离的指令来扩展FIM结构。
tldr: 提出指令感知中间填充（IFIM）微调方法，通过在FIM结构中引入结构分离的专门指令部分，使代码补全模型能够有效理解并优先处理开发者的自然语言指令，从而实现可控的代码补全。
en_tdlr: We propose Instruction-aware Fill-In-the-Middle (IFIM), a fine-tuning method that extends the FIM structure with dedicated, structurally separated instructions, enabling code completion models to effectively understand and prioritize developers' natural language directives for steerable code completion.
